meta.goal: Design a battery for power tools: nominal capacity >= 2 Ah, support 5C discharge (capacity retention >= 95%), support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60 C, power density >= 4000 W/kg.
meta.base_params_basis: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (baseline teaching parameterization); materials use system baseline
meta.retention_5c_definition: 5C_discharge (dfn) capacity / 1C_discharge (dfn) capacity, same parameters; mechanically computed
meta.T_max_definition: max cell temperature under 4C_charge_45C protocol (thermal lumped, ambient 318.15 K); 60 C = 333.15 K
meta.plated_definition: anode_potential_v min < 0 V during 4C charge -> plated=true

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (start Chen2020 per anchor default; switch only if ceiling assessment infeasible)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: adjustable (transport parameter overrides: Electrolyte conductivity/diffusivity, Cation transference number)
freedoms.cell_architecture: adjustable (electrode thickness/porosity/N-P, separator thickness/porosity, current collector thickness, particle radius)

objective_breakdown: 5 metrics: capacity_ah>=2.0 (baseline 5.0, easy); retention_5c>=0.95 (baseline likely 60-75%, hard; levers: thin electrodes, high porosity, small particles, high electrolyte transport); power_density_w_kg>=4000 (baseline est. 1.3-1.6k, hardest; P=Voc^2/4DCR/mass -> ~1/thickness^2 scaling via thin electrodes + mass cut); T_max_K<=333.15 under 4C charge at 318.15 K ambient (DeltaT<=15 K; P_heat/(h*A) with A=0.00531 m2 -> low-DCR design + cooling h); plated=false at 4C charge (thin anode, small neg particles, high anode porosity, high sigma_e; 45 C ambient helps kinetics). Trade-off: thinner electrodes help retention/power/heat but cut capacity toward the 2.0 Ah bound.
candidate_strategy: R0: baseline Chen2020 characterization (1C dfn + calc-energy, 5C dfn, 4C charge 45C dfn lumped+plating) + opening ceiling assessment (thin electrode + high-sigma electrolyte + high h combo limits). R1: 2-3 thin-electrode architecture variants preserving N/P (V1 ~0.6x thickness + small neg particles + electrolyte transport boost + h; V2 ~0.45-0.5x; V3 porosity/particle refinement). Fallback: retention/power/T -> Stage 3 params; plating -> anode particle/porosity/sigma; 3 strikes -> question assumptions (system switch or negative result).
budget_allocation: R0: 3 dfn sims + 1 calc-energy. R1-R3: <=3 candidates/round, each 1C dfn + 5C dfn + 4C dfn (+calc-energy for passers). Closing: deliverables, render, verify-deliverables. Flash target ~15-20 min wall clock.
risk_and_fallback: Risk1: 4000 W/kg may be unreachable for Chen2020 even at 35 um (positive solid sigma=0.18 S/m excluded lever) -> ceiling assessment; escalate to system switch or negative result with relaxation note. Risk2: 95% 5C retention needs ~35-40 um electrodes -> capacity ~2.3-2.6 Ah, monitor >=2.0. Risk3: T_max headroom only 15 K -> need P_heat<=8 W at h=100 W/m2/K; verify via sim. Risk4: 4C plating -> small neg particles (measured +14.6 contribution), anode porosity, sigma_e. Three-strike layers: model/system reachability, task boundary (h, system switch scope - widest interpretation recorded), metric reachability.

detail: start_stage=3: this case starts at Stage 3 (cell design); Stage 2 molecular screening skipped. Base parameter set = Chen2020 (anchor-table default: task text names no electrode system). Matching basis: Chen2020 = baseline teaching parameterization (NMC/graphite, 5 Ah nominal, no complete thermal/geometry set -> run-pyamm injects thermal defaults with trace). Materials props source marked baseline (literature values); no parameter overrides in R0.

candidates.name: Baseline Chen2020
candidates.role: baseline characterization: 1C discharge (dfn) + 5C discharge (dfn) + 4C charge at 45C (dfn, lumped thermal, plating) on the unmodified Chen2020 parameter set; quantifies gaps and supports the opening ceiling assessment

llm_reason: R0 runs the unmodified system to measure where each metric stands (5C retention, power density, T_max, plating) before proposing architecture variants; zero parameter overrides so gaps are attributable to the system itself.

candidates.name: V1 Power-thin 0.55x
candidates.role: main power-cell architecture: electrodes thinned to ~55% (42/52 um), porosity raised (0.40/0.35), small particles (1.0/1.5 um), high-transport electrolyte (sigma=2.0 S/m, D=3e-10, t+=0.4), forced-air cooling h=100 W/m2/K; est. capacity ~2.5 Ah

candidates.name: V2 Power-thin 0.47x
candidates.role: thinner fallback (36/44 um) if V1 retention or T_max still short; est. capacity ~2.2 Ah (near the 2.0 Ah bound)

candidates.name: V3 Transport-only
candidates.role: diagnostic: baseline geometry with high-transport electrolyte + cooling only; isolates electrolyte contribution to 5C retention / plating / T_max

llm_reason: Baseline R0: retention_5c=0.087, plated=true, T_max=354.3 K fail; power_density=22383 W/kg and capacity=4.95 Ah already pass. Root cause of 5C collapse: positive solid diffusivity 4e-15 m2/s gives particle diffusion time constant ~6.8 ks (r=5.22 um) >> 720 s 5C window; solid diffusivity is an excluded lever, so particle radius is the allowed fix (t1 precedent: small particle +14.6 contribution). R1 packages the levers: thin electrodes (ionic path + mass + heat), raised porosity (ionic resistance + plating), small particles (diffusion + plating), high-transport electrolyte (sigma 2.0 S/m ~2.1x baseline, D 3e-10 ~1.7x, t+ 0.4; estimates with literature basis: Xu Chem. Rev. 2004, high-conductivity LiFSI-class formulations), h=100 forced-air (T_max). Params listed above with sources: thickness/porosity/particle = design values; electrolyte transport = estimate (literature-adjacent); h = design (domain experience). V3 isolates the electrolyte effect.

candidates.name: V4 Margin-fix
candidates.role: R1 V1 + targeted plating fix: anode potential min was -3.9 mV only at the final charge instant (anode surface fills, U_neg+eta < 0); fix = thicker negative (52->58 um, N/P up), epsilon_neg 0.35->0.38, r_neg 1.5->1.0 um, r_pos 1.0->0.8 um (charge acceptance), t+ 0.4->0.5, sigma 2.0->2.4 S/m, D 3e-10->3.5e-10

candidates.name: V5 Anode-only
candidates.role: isolates whether anode geometry alone (thicker negative 58 um, epsilon_neg 0.38, r_neg 1.0 um) clears the plating line without the extra transport boost of V4

llm_reason: R1 verdicts: V1/V2 pass capacity/retention/power/T_max but fail plated by only 3.9 mV / 8.6 mV at the final charge instant; V3 (transport-only) fails (retention 0.064 with SPMe fallback, plated=true) -> electrolyte transport is not the dominant 5C limiter; geometry+particles carry retention. Targeted R2 (informed rerun, same scale): increase negative margin (N/P 1.05->1.17) so U_neg floor is higher at end of charge, lower anode overpotential (smaller r_neg, higher epsilon_neg, higher t+/sigma), and smaller r_pos for better 4C charge acceptance. V5 keeps transport at V1 level to attribute the plating fix to anode geometry alone. Params listed; thickness/porosity/particle = design values, transport = estimate (literature-adjacent, Xu Chem. Rev. 2004).

note: Baseline: capacity and power density pass (4.95 Ah, 22383 W/kg); 5C retention 0.087 fails hard (positive solid D=4e-15 m2/s -> tau ~6.8 ks), 4C charge plated (anode min -0.19 V) and T_max 354.3 K > 333.15 K fail
V1: capacity 3.08 Ah, retention 0.983, power density 112930 W/kg, T_max 323.3 K all pass; plated=true marginal (-3.9 mV only at the final charge instant at 4.2 V cutoff)
V2: capacity 2.61 Ah, retention 0.981, T_max 323.4 K pass; plated=true marginal (-8.6 mV at final charge instant)

detail: Opening ceiling assessment (baseline characterization): levers assessed = electrode thickness/porosity, particle radius (positive solid D fixed 4e-15 m2/s -> particle size is the only allowed diffusion lever), electrolyte transport (sigma/t+/D), cooling h. Baseline limits measured: retention_5c=0.087 (bottleneck: positive particle diffusion tau~6.8 ks at r=5.22 um vs 720 s 5C window), plated=true, T_max=354.3 K (h=10). Gap to objective: retention +86.3 pts, T -21.2 K, plating margin -0.19 V. Ceiling assessment conclusion: Chen2020 architecture space with small particles (r<=1 um -> tau<=250 s), thin electrodes (<=42 um), raised porosity and high-transport electrolyte + forced-air cooling (h=100) is estimated to reach all objectives; no material escalation (Stage 2) needed - architecture/electrolyte/thermal levers suffice (confirmed empirically in R1-R2).

note: V4: all 5 criteria pass; plating fixed (anode min +22.6 mV); retention 0.987, T_max 321.9 K
V5: all 5 criteria pass; anode-geometry-only fix clears plating (anode min +16.0 mV) even with V1-level transport; retention 0.983, T_max 322.5 K

reason: real_compute=false: true DFT/MD endorsement (run-orca/run-md) skipped per protocol; no fabricated DFT/MD values. All conclusion-grade values sourced from DFN cell simulations (run-pyamm) and calc-energy.

recommendation: Final design: V4 Margin-fix on Chen2020 base (NMC/graphite). Parameters: positive 42 um eps 0.40 r 0.8 um; negative 58 um eps 0.38 r 1.0 um; separator 12 um; Al 16 um / Cu 12 um collectors; high-transport electrolyte sigma=2.4 S/m, D=3.5e-10 m2/s, t+=0.5; cooling h=100 W/m2/K. Measured (all DFN, evidence in evaluate R2): capacity 3.438 Ah >= 2.0; 5C retention 0.987 >= 0.95; power density 111807 W/kg >= 4000; T_max 321.94 K (48.8 C) <= 333.15 K; plated=false (anode potential min +22.6 mV). Conservative alternative: V5 (anode-geometry-only fix, plated=false +16.0 mV). Honest notes: (1) 4C CC charge phase delivers 0.617 Ah before hitting the 4.2 V cutoff (slow cathode solid diffusion 4e-15 m2/s -> surface U_pos rise); a real charger would continue in CV; no plating occurs in the CC phase. (2) Power density is the contract-caliber theoretical peak P=Voc^2/4R/mass. (3) Cycle life not simulated (no aging criterion in task). No three-strike escalation needed (objective achieved in 3 rounds).
